lane: native local, plaintext (RE_TLS off); machine semantics, not transport
universe: startUniverse.sh --engines=cpp:1,lsp:1,scala:1 --machine-corpus=extension --no-openclaw --free-ports; rust-1 and go-1 beside it on the same corpus and width, as scripts/follower-conformance.sh starts them
candidates: the 18 GOV machines registered at run time by POST /api/machines on every RE, once; every declared region honoured
buildProvenance: verify-build-provenance.py: every engine built from its current source
method: per simulation and engine: reset RE and PE, remove sources in the band [16960:17430), create the simulation's simulated Sources, push `steps` times, read the machine's output region from each step's perceptualSpace; compare the voters 3-of-3, each follower with the voters, and the voters with the latched expectation (GOV-SD-19)
feedback: 35 simulations drive a GOV-SA-06 latch. The PE composition that feeds the feedback cell is not implemented on any engine (GOV-R12), so the probe held a sensor Source there and wrote the LATCH value the engine committed on the previous step: those results are harness-composed.
findings: All 145 simulations agree 3-of-3 and match the latched expectation; Rust and Go agree on all 145.

The engines write an all-zero output vector: 7 simulations write an output and later clear it to all-zero, gov12-closed (GOV-SA-20) and the GOV-SA-23 idle clears among them, identically on five engines.
Continuous values 0.0001 inside a band edge (GOV-SA-01) stay in band: 19 simulations drive one, and all match (GOV-R32).
